advisory.summary: uncontrolled resource consumption: expandHandler allocates a slice sized by an attacker-controlled count with no upper bound, faulting the process

acquisition.notes: Patched variant of FERRALON-APP-DOS-0001: the same expandHandler bounds count to maxCount (1 MiB) before make([]byte, n), so an oversized count is rejected with 413 and the allocation never faults. Single-file Go module, structurally identical to the vulnerable variant except the bound.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: expandHandler bounds the attacker-controlled count before allocation, so the make never faults and the CWE-400 sink is code-foreclosed on this build. The call path from ingress to the allocation still exists (static_taint_path_complete) but the guarded implementation is not exploitable; reasoned rather than proven because proving non-exploitability requires the two-trace (Phase 3, PoNE). KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
